newsitem.title: CHINA: Silver Grant mulls convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: Silver Grant mulls convertible bonds.

text.p: Silver Grant International Industries Ltd said on Friday it was considering the issue of up to US$115 million in convertible bonds, due in 2004.
The company said in a statement it was considering issuing up to US$100 million in bonds with an option to issue up to US$15 million more.

About US$15 million of the proceeds would be used to finance further investments in Beijing Wang Fu Jing Retail Management Co Ltd and about US$30 million to finance further investments in China Infra-Structure Investment Ltd, Silver Grant said.

It said about US$30 million would also be used to finance future projects in China's non-ferrous metals indsutry which could include the setting up of joint ventures with parties including China Nonferrous Metals Holdings (Hong Kong) Ltd.
The balance of the proceeds would be used for general working capital.
Silver Grant said it had appointed ABN AMRO Bank N.V. and NM Rothschild & Sons Ltd to lead manage the proposed issue.
